'''Sector 5''' was the theater of operations of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fifth Deep Core Army|5th Sector Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it was reorganized into an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oversector/Legends|Priority Sector]] and placed under the rule of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Cinzero Gann|Gann]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

Located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], it contained [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] within the [[Prakith system/Legends|Prakith system]].<ref name="SoL" />
